quest.title: Witch's Lodge
quest.description: While taking a walk through Nod-Krai, you stumble into a mysterious place...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Heh... Alright, time to get to work.

#A long, long time ago, there was a young {M#man}{F#woman} who ran away from home. After spending the last of {M#his}{F#her} Mora, {M#he}{F#she} trod through the cold of winter, shivering in {M#his}{F#her} threadbare clothes...

#Suddenly, the young {M#man}{F#woman} found {M#himself}{F#herself} stepping out onto thin air, and {M#he}{F#she} fell through into a strange place. But before {M#he}{F#she} could react, a voice rang out from somewhere in the distance:
"This is the secret home of Nicola Coco, the Great Mage Everlasting. Oh, destitute one, tell me your heart's greatest wish, and with my guidance, you shall attain it."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... That was a strange voice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Nicola Coco"... Who's that again? Do we know her?
#The young {M#man}{F#woman} was in awe of the mage's magnificence and beauty. After a lengthy silence, {M#he}{F#she} solemnly declared:
"O great mage from afar, how beauteous and wise you are! The moment I beheld you, my heart began to flutter. All my heart desires now is to make your wishes mine."

The subtlest of smiles appeared on the mage's face as she replied: "Very well. Then I shall task you with performing certain deeds on my behalf, such as those that are within your ability. Your guide is here, and your reward awaits you in the days to come."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guide? ...Does that mean this glowing orb?
"Secret home..." said the young wanderer, with a look of confusion on their face. "Where is this 'secret home' of which you speak?"
The mage's voice grew somewhat flustered upon hearing this question...
(Wait, does it make sense for this to be a bashful character? ...Eh, never mind — I'll keep it in for now. Mr. Nine can always refine it later.)
"Ahem, it is rather rude to ask such questions of a mage, young one. The mage's lodge is under renovation. Very soon, you shall be stunned by its grandeur."
"This shall be your trial. Offer up your strength, and help this great mage to build her territory."

talks.objective: Find an appropriate target to photograph

dialogues.text: "Well then, young one. Now, you have learned of the troubles faced by this mage... Nicola Coco requires your aid to build her sacred territory."
The mage poured a cup of tea for her visitor. "What say you?"

choices.text: It is my honor to serve!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! Shouldn't we think twice before going all in on this? We don't know anything about this person. And she seems a little weird...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Although, having said that, this teacup looks kinda familiar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nicola Coco... Ah! Is it... Mage "N"? Nicole?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Correct. What do you think of my story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Hard to say. It's not finished yet, surely? What happens to the characters in the end?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: I haven't decided yet. I need to renovate my home first. Perhaps I'll have a burst of inspiration after that.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Anyway, if you can hear my voice, I assume that means you're currently in Nod-Krai. In which case, could I trouble you to gather a few things for me?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Well, I'd like to build a few more statues to decorate my home, but I'm lacking inspiration at the moment. I was thinking you could take some photos to give me some ideas.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you serious? ...Alright then. Leave it to us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait here — we'll head out and see what we can find. But remember to finish the story once the statues are done!

choices.text: Is it something to do with statues?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Exactly. I'm thinking of building a few more statues to decorate my home, but I'm lacking inspiration at the moment. So, I was thinking you could take some photos to give me some ideas.

choices.text: Great mage Nicola Coco, I will do as you command!

talks.objective: Find an appropriate target to photograph

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Just who I wanted to see.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I'm delighted with the photos you took — excellent source material. Now — I have all the carving tools ready to go. Would you like to try it together?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Carving tools? ...You mean these blocks?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: That's right. The statues are inside the stones. All we need to do is remove any excess material.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: To make things a little easier for you, I've provided a guide on how the carving process works.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Allow me to demonstrate. First, we make some big, bold cuts to carve out the general shape...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: The numbers on the stones represent the amount of material you need to keep in a given column. So, first we do this... and then this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, it's starting to take shape!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Got it? If you carve the blocks this way, you should be able to see the basic form.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Then, you just need to add some finishing touches... and, voila!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what!? It suddenly changed in the blink of an eye! How'd you do that?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Hah, a great mage doesn't reveal her secrets that easily. Just behold, and be amazed.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You got the basic carving process down, yes? Focus on that, and leave the finishing touches to me. Much obliged.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's give this a shot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the...!? This is way more difficult than the one you walked us through!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, sorry, sorry. Wrong one.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: That's the one I was going to work on. Yours is over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Well, that's a relief...

talks.objective: Find an appropriate target to photograph

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Mm, the mage's story is starting to taking shape. I think I'll delegate this next section to Mr. Nine.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: A great mage is defined above all by her beauty and powerful presence. Perhaps an exaggerated laugh might help her stand out more.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: "Ohohohoho! It looks like someone has been bewitched by the power of the Great Mage Everlasting!" ...Is that laugh too annoying? No, it'll be fine — it's all in writing anyway. No one will hear it out loud.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: My renovation plan is complete... But where to start? Everyone knows you can't just conjure a house out of thin air. Hmm... Or could I?

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Alchemy could work. The only raw materials I need are bricks and wood... Yes, I'll go with that. Far easier than building everything by hand.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: A mage's home has to look very different from an ordinary house. I'm just not sure what that means in practice.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: One thing's for certain, though — it has to be an ancient, mysterious, and otherworldly place that will endure for hundreds, even thousands of years.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Yes, that's good. Just what people would expect from a mage. Although in truth, it's not so much me capturing moments in time as moments in time that have captured me... hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Well don't just stand there! Go, complete the task that the great mage has assigned!

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: And remember, I don't want to see anything dull and dreary. I need photos that are bursting with life, so I can capture the soul and character of the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Don't be thinking that carving a statue is just about shapes and proportions. The most important thing is to capture the spirit of the subject in the moment the photograph is taken... Alright. Got all that?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon take a bunch of photos...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, some of these shots are pretty good, but we didn't get any from the front. Let's wait for it to turn around...

dialogues.speaker: Mandragora
dialogues.text: Roar!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the one! That's the money shot!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waaaaaah! Help!

talks.objective: Take the pictures back to the cave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Nicole, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: That was quick! You two work very fast.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's nothing. But uh, how do we get the photos to you?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You can hold onto them for now. I'll be there in a couple of days — we can talk more about the statues then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure thing. See you in a couple days!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now we just need Nicole to add the finishing touches...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You got rid of all the extraneous stone, yes? Let me take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's done!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's the mage's lodge! When did that get there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this the power of a mage?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: "Is this the power of a mage?" The young visitor's voice was filled with wonder. "I am truly amazed."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! Finally, the story continues! So, what happened to the mage and her young visitor?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: They lived happily ever after...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: ...The end.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: *sigh* Tough customers, huh? Well, if you're that eager to hear it, I suppose I'll take it from the top...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: #"All my heart desires now is to make your wishes mine," said the young {M#man}{F#woman}. Those words won {M#him}{F#her} the full attention of the great mage, Nicola Coco.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But just as they had started warming up to one another, a group of uninvited guests stormed in, seized the mage, and absconded with her!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As the youngster stood there in shock, a new mage by the name of Alynas appeared. She signed a contract with the youngster, bestowing the power of magic upon them.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But after making it through a grueling training program, they would come to discover another conspiracy operating in the background!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As it turned out, the great mage Nicola Coco was an alien entity. Her true identity was the first daughter of King Meowtres the Third of Planet Meow.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: She had come disguised as a mage as part of a secret plot to trick the entire world into worshiping Planet Meow!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "O great mage... have you been lying to me all this while?" The youngster's voice trembled as their heart began to break.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "Leave me. War is destined to break out between our planet and yours. We were foes from the very start."

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: The mage turned her face away, refusing to let anyone see the tears welling up in her eyes...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But the youngster bravely reached out and grabbed her by the arm, swearing to never leave her. Moved by this display of passion, the mage decided to rebel!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But in that moment, Alynas who had once aided the youngster, now took the side of the king.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alynas had been Meowtres the Third's second daughter all along. She had only helped the youngster in the hopes that her sister might be incited to treason, thus giving her the chance to usurp Nicola's place in the line of succession...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Nicole continues with the long and rambling tale. Many a bizarre plot twist later, even the protagonist is no longer a human being...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Anyway, that's the gist of it. In the end, the youngster — who by this point had turned into a cat — worked with the mage to successfully foil the king's plot. Then, they returned to the mage's lodge together, and lived happily ever after in peace and quiet. The end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sniff* That was amazing... This story has everything! True love... rebellion against injustice...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Feels like it started as one story and ended as another...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: That can't be helped. All creations escape the controlling grasp of their creator eventually.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: We angels are a case in point. Once, we were tasked with guiding human beings, but because some of us chose a different path, our entire race was punished.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: If even the Heavenly Principles can't fully control their own creations... What chance do I stand?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Fate is always ineffable, and yet... I still hope I can guide those I meet towards a happy ending to their tale. That applies to characters in my stories as well.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Anyway, the story's over now, and I'm running a little low on energy. Next time I've got a good story to tell, I'll share it with you, alright?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alynas had been Meowtres the Third's second daughter all along.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: She had only helped the youngster in the hopes that her sister might be incited to treason,

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: thus giving her the chance to usurp Nicola's place in the line of succession...

choices.text: You left out the entire middle of the story!

dialogues.text: #As the young {M#man}{F#woman} continued forth, {M#he}{F#she} noticed many exquisite statues dotting the mage's territory. "What are these?" {M#He}{F#She} asked, puzzled.
"These are all those who opposed me. They underestimated the power of a mage, and thus were turned to stone."

Hmm, I quite like that. A spur-of-the-moment addition, but dare I say it was a good one. A mage ought to be a powerful and dangerous figure... Danger lends a certain mystique, and without mystique, the world would be a very dim place.

(But turning people to stone at the drop of a hat... is that too over the top? And no one wants to be around someone that capricious... Okay, I think I'll dial it back and turn it into more of a vague warning.)

Upon hearing this, the youngster broke into a cold sweat. But then, the mage's laughter broke the silence: "Haha... Did you fall for it? I was merely joking. These statues are just my way of capturing a certain moment in time."
"Anyway, statues. That's what I need your help with. The mage's lodge is feeling a little empty, and I should like to fill the space with some more adorable companions."

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: "Ohohohoho! It looks like someone has been bewitched by the power of the Great Mage Everlasting!"

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: ...Is that laugh too annoying?

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: No, it'll be fine — it's all in writing anyway. No one will hear it out loud.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Yes, that's good. Just what people would expect from a mage.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: Although in truth, it's not so much me capturing moments in time as moments in time that have captured me... hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look over there. Are those finches?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They look pretty lively, don't they? Seems like a good first photo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Where shall we go for the next photo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, we saw a squirrel statue earlier, didn't we? Do you think Nicole likes squirrels?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's snap a few photos to take back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that... a Mandragora?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks that would make a pretty fun statue!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That was scary! Paimon wasn't expecting it to jump us like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Go on, {NICKNAME}! You got this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, that should do it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's kept all the pictures safe. Let's go back to see Nicole.
